description: Command: on an operator's explicit request, retire the one uncertain approval marker without an attention ID that a session holds on one turn (Hub #835, carrying the old Hub's recover-approval operation). The envelope subject is the session's `id` (validator). `expectedRevision` is the session record's `revision` that the operator read, so a record that changed meanwhile is refused with `revision-conflict`. The core (#831) clears the marker only while the session's evidence is uncertain (five minutes without evidence, or since a restart), publishes `attention-cleared` with cause `recovered` and the session record at a new revision, and replies `accepted` once that has committed; no outcome follows. It approves or denies nothing at the agent, and fresh approval evidence can raise a new marker. The reply uses the profile's reply payload.
